_comment: Shared parity fixture for T509 and T782: JavaScript drops these zones because the popup already renders them, and Python must reject the same choices in Settings. Both suites assert this file so changing a built-in clock requires both implementations to move together.
_spellings_comment: TZ takes a POSIX colon prefix and an absolute path, and GLib does not canonicalize: get_identifier() answers the string it was given. So one zone reaches the built-in comparison spelled three ways depending only on how the session was started, and both sides reduce it the same way before comparing.
